comments.author: Steward
comments.body:
Quest is called "The great desert"

1. Talk to the Resident in Algiers
2. Talk to the Customer in Algiers
3. Talk to the Rest house master in Algiers
4. Talk to the Rest house master in Algiers
5. Have a drink with the Rest house master in Algiers
6. Africa North Coast - Observe Recognition

comments.author: Hawka
comments.body:
This quest stays the same. But instead of using observe in the North African land, You will move south to move to another passage which leads to the Great Desert "Al Sahara Al Kubra"...
Some info I collected there:
You can procure Water, Ants, Shipwreck Map pieces "Hard" and Sand
You can collect Sand and Water

comments.author: SiM
comments.body: Just to add,you can also find Rusty short sword,Cross-strap sandals,Quadrant,Travellers notes,Iron-wire hunting net.
